M0.prediction: positive training decisions / known-label training decisions

weights: one per observed decision; no class or event weights

preprocessing.imputation: training median; all-missing training column uses fixed 0 with missing indicator
preprocessing.indicators: one fixed missing indicator per allowed feature
preprocessing.scaling: training mean and population SD for imputed base features; SD 0 becomes 1; indicators unscaled
preprocessing.transformations: all base features untransformed before scaling

unknown_labels: excluded from supervised training and binary metrics; retained in population and selection summaries

uncertainty.method: paired player bootstrap of fixed out-of-fold predictions; percentiles 2.5 and 97.5; undefined replicates reported

alerts.threshold: smallest distinct training OOF score with fraction(score>=threshold)<=0.05; if none, +infinity
alerts.inner_folds: hash same player key modulo 4 with prefix phase3a-alert-20240221; no redraw
alerts.denominator: 100 observed eligible decisions; no player-week rate

sensitivity: additional local calendar day timing; same player folds
exclude all observations of any player with an included MEM decision; no fold redraw
exclude retrospectively linked already disclosed same-acute positive opportunities; report outcome-conditioned population limitation
